<div class="eyebrow">About</div>

# Why this site exists

<p class="lead">
I built this mainly so I would have something live to point to on a resume or a LinkedIn
profile: a working example of how I approach a dataset, rather than a static writeup. The
exploratory analysis, the data quality checks, the classifier, and the interactive comparison
tool are all meant to show that process end to end, on a small public dataset, in the open.
</p>

<p>
It is also a deliberately small example. The dataset behind it is cross-sectional, six
variables, about a thousand rows before accounting for the duplicate records flagged in the
report. For a sense of how I work with larger, messier, and more structurally complex data, the
two links below are a better reference than this site on its own.
</p>
